name: Customer buys a plant
summary: A customer browses the Fern & Fig plant catalogue, opens a plant they like, adds it to their cart, signs in and pays — finishing on an order-confirmation screen. The journey is honest about the ways a purchase can fail: an empty cart has nothing to check out, a plant can sell out between the cart and payment, and a payment can be declined. If the plant they want is already sold out on the detail page, they can ask to be notified instead of buying.

acceptance_scenarios.given: the catalog has in-stock and out-of-stock plants
acceptance_scenarios.then: each plant shows its price and a stock badge (in stock / low / out of stock)

acceptance_scenarios.when: the customer opens its detail page
acceptance_scenarios.then: they can add it to the cart

acceptance_scenarios.given: a plant has been added to the cart
acceptance_scenarios.then: the cart shows the plant, quantity, unit price and a running total before they pay

acceptance_scenarios.when: the customer opens its detail page
acceptance_scenarios.then: the add-to-cart button is replaced by a 'Notify me' action
an empty-cart message is shown, no total or pay button is offered, and a link back to the catalogue is provided

acceptance_scenarios.given: an unauthenticated customer with items in their cart
acceptance_scenarios.then: they are asked to sign in (or create an account) and their cart is preserved once signed in

acceptance_scenarios.given: a cart with at least one item and a signed-in customer
acceptance_scenarios.when: the customer pays and the payment is approved
acceptance_scenarios.then: an Order is created with status 'paid' and the confirmation screen is shown

acceptance_scenarios.given: a cart with at least one item and a signed-in customer
acceptance_scenarios.when: the customer pays and the payment is declined
acceptance_scenarios.then: no Order is created, the cart is preserved, and a clear payment-declined error offers another payment method

acceptance_scenarios.given: a cart holding a plant that has since dropped to zero stock
acceptance_scenarios.then: payment is blocked, no Order is created, and the customer is told the item is no longer available
the confirmation screen shows the order number and the paid items
